style: Figurative flat illustration for a printed German study book, in the spirit of a mid-century children's picture book with a touch of graphic simplification and a sense of humour: subjects drawn naturally and instantly recognizable, with real proportions and simple friendly faces, details reduced to clean flat colour shapes, medium-weight ink-navy outlines, no gradients, no textures. Limited warm palette: ink-navy, terracotta, mustard, sage, soft blue and cream. The drawing floats on a plain pure white background with generous empty margins on every side; nothing touches the edges of the image, no background colour field, no frame. Food and objects never have faces. No text, no letters, no numbers, no digits, no writing on signs or labels, no watermark. Never write any colour codes, hex values, numbers, labels or signatures anywhere in the picture.

images.prompt: An elegant writer at an old wooden desk choosing between three fountain pens of different sizes laid out like tools, a pile of crumpled drafts at her feet, and a cat sitting on the dictionary with a monocle-like reflection on its eye. Papers have only wavy lines, no text. Natural skin colours.

A courtroom scene seen from the front: a judge with a gavel, two lawyers in robes shaking hands to settle, and a nervous businessman holding a falling bar chart made of cardboard; a pigeon sits on the judge’s bench. No text. Natural skin colours.

The same man shown three times side by side: in a hoodie lounging with a soft drink, in a smart shirt at a desk, and in a dinner suit giving a formal toast; his dog follows him dressed to match each outfit. Natural skin colours.

A football team in muddy shirts walking off the pitch after a bitter defeat, heads down, while the referee offers them an umbrella and a duck in the stands holds a tiny flag. Natural skin colours, no text.
An old man holding one coin very carefully, seen twice: on the left with a warm golden glow and smiling friends, on the right in a cold blue light with a frowning neighbour. Natural skin colours.

A food critic at a restaurant table holding a fork up and judging a dish with a very precise, raised-eyebrow expression, while the chef peeks nervously from the kitchen door and a mouse waits for the leftovers. Natural skin colours.
A man in a small glass house about to throw a stone, then hesitating, while next door a sly fox has fallen into a pit it dug itself. Natural skin colours, no text.
Three city skylines side by side in a row, from small to very big, with a tiny tourist on a ladder measuring the tallest tower with a tape measure. No text, no numbers.
A town square memorial ceremony: people stand quietly with flowers before a simple stone, a mayor bows his head, and a small child holds her grandfather’s hand. Natural skin colours, no text.

A long train made of many carriages, each carriage a different object linked together (a book, a shop, a station, a clock), with the last carriage being a big locomotive at the front on the right. No text.
A carpenter proudly presenting a masterly, finely carved wooden chair to a client, who checks it with a magnifying glass, while a squirrel tests the chair by sitting on it. Natural skin colours.

A man at a kitchen table doing his tax return, surrounded by papers and a calculator, clearly realising he has made a big mistake, with his cat walking across the calculator keys. Papers have only lines. Natural skin colours.
A man on a mountain path who almost slipped, catching himself on a branch at the edge with one foot in the air, while a mountain goat watches calmly from a rock. Natural skin colours.

A businessman at a long table hesitating with a fountain pen above a contract, a stern lawyer on one side and a hopeful partner on the other, and a clock on the wall without numbers. Natural skin colours, no text.
A potter at a wheel reshaping a vase into a bowl, the same clay in a new shape, while a cat on the shelf watches a row of previous pots of different shapes. Natural skin colours.

A newspaper editor at a desk holding a telephone and taking careful notes, with a second reporter leaning in to listen, and a stack of newspapers with only lines on them. Natural skin colours, no text.

A city at dawn seen from a bridge: houses with closed shutters like sleeping eyes, a single lit window like a small island in the dark, traffic lights changing for nobody, and a pigeon on the railing. No text.

A speaker at a lectern on a town square giving a passionate speech with one raised hand, a crowd listening, and a child on her father’s shoulders holding a balloon. No text on banners. Natural skin colours.

A television panel discussion: a calm moderator in the middle raising one hand to stop a man and a woman who are both talking at once, with a cameraman in the foreground. No text. Natural skin colours.

A town hall office with a huge modern touch screen on the wall, while the clerk below it uses a fax machine, a typewriter and a rubber stamp; a pigeon delivers a letter through the window. Screen blank, no text. Natural skin colours.

A quiet kitchen in the morning: an old man sits at a table with one white cup, and opposite him an empty chair by the window with a blue cup on the windowsill; through the window a neighbour rolls a bin across the yard. Natural skin colours.
